title: Sable Dynamic Lights (Create: Dynamic Lights fork)
description: Adds dynamic lighting to Create contraptions and Sable sub-levels.
body:
![Demonstration](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/KKb9KQzX/images/2b212dac05f7e38c692b5aaac9147f7da0f2986f.gif)

**This mod is a fork of [Create: Dynamic Lights](https://modrinth.com/project/evMQRxqV) by Leon.**

Sable Dynamic Lights integrates real-time dynamic lighting for moving structures. The mod introduces dynamic light support for glowing blocks placed on Create trains and contraptions. It also enables seamless dynamic lighting on moving Sable sub-levels. Powered by the LambDynamicLights engine, all calculations and rendering are smooth and efficient. Torches, glowstone, and lanterns will realistically illuminate the environment as trains travel or pistons move.

## Dependencies:

*   [Create](https://modrinth.com/project/LNytGWDc)
*   [LambDynamicLights](https://modrinth.com/project/yBW8D80W)
*   [Sable](https://modrinth.com/project/T9PomCSv) (optional)
